mapper.insert: insert into course (course_name, coach_id, course_price, course_intro, course_detail, sale_status, create_time) values (#{courseName}, #{coachId}, #{coursePrice}, #{courseIntro}, #{courseDetail}, #{saleStatus}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update course set course_name = #{courseName}, coach_id = #{coachId}, course_price = #{coursePrice}, course_intro = #{courseIntro}, course_detail = #{courseDetail}, sale_status = #{saleStatus} where course_id = #{courseId}
